tasks.spec:
Create a NEW ES-module worker_personality.js giving each guild worker a PERSONALITY with a distinct voice. worker_visitor.js (injected) is your PATTERN (self-installing ES module, no imports, no top-level DOM access, typeof guards, state on a window global, update(now)/draw(ctx) hooks, __probe for testing). worker_office.js (injected) is REFERENCE ONLY (drawing conventions, palette, worker states).

Client contract (all on window): V (V.gameState, V.workers array with name/recent_ticks, V.workerStates), iso(gx, gy), fitText, window.cue optional sound hook. The client calls update/draw every frame when V.gameState === 'play'.

BEHAVIOR — window.GuildPersonality with update/draw/__probe (__probe returns the current active quip):
1. ARCHETYPES (hardcode): missingno = GLITCHY TRICKSTER (speaks in fragmented corrupted text: 'c0mpleted... hehe', 'another one f0r the collection'); step5 = ALOOF POET (melancholy one-liners about deadlines and moonlight); laguna = EAGER ROOKIE (overexcited, exclamation marks, 'did I do good??'); longcat = SERENE PHILOSOPHER (calm koan-like observations, cat references).
2. Every 14-22s pick one worker AT RANDOM and show a quip bubble above them for 5s (dark box, gold #d4af37 border, white text, clipped, measured with fitText to 150px, tail pointing down, fade in/out 0.4s, y always > 60 to clear the HUD, only one at a time). The quip text = a voice-flavored line derived from that worker's REAL newest recent_ticks string (paraphrase it in the archetype's voice; if no ticks use an idle line in-voice).
3. Nameplate flourish: draw a small accent glyph above each worker's head next to their name — missingno gets a tiny glitch square (random 2px offset flicker), step5 a tiny crescent, laguna a tiny star, longcat a tiny whisker pair. Map by V.workers index 0-3 with name fallbacks.
4. Zero exceptions if workers/recent_ticks arrays are missing or empty. update guards on window.V && V.gameState === 'play'.

OUTPUT: only the new file, wrapped in one standard fenced code block (three backticks, no language tag). One line of prose max outside the fence.

tasks.spec:
Create a NEW ES-module worker_museum.js — a GUILD MUSEUM CORNER that turns the island into the repo: pedestals whose plaques auto-generate from the guild's REAL task history. worker_visitor.js (injected) is your PATTERN; worker_office.js (injected) is REFERENCE ONLY.

Contract (all on window): V (V.gameState, V.allTasks — array of {id, title, status} objects, V.workerStates, V.growthStep), iso(gx, gy), fitText, window.GuildVisitor {gx, gy} optional.

BEHAVIOR — window.GuildMuseum = { pedestals: [], nextRefresh: 0, highlight: null } with update/draw/__probe (probe returns pedestal count):
1. Pedestals: up to 6 pedestals arranged in two rows of three in a corner (tiles around gx -4.5..-2.5, gy 3.5..5.5 — northwest-south floor area; pick positions that stay on the grown island by clamping ring to V.growthStep - 1). Each pedestal: stone-gray block (3-4 fillRects, #8d99ae top #6b7280 base) with a small exhibit artifact on top (choose per status: a golden gear for done, an amber scroll for pending, a red broken cog for failed).
2. Plaque: a small plate under each pedestal with the task id + truncated title (fitText 80px). Status color: done gold #facc15, pending amber #f59e0b, failed red #ef4444.
3. Assign exhibits from V.allTasks: prefer the 6 most interesting (mix: newest done + any pending/failed; stable order by id so they do not flicker — refresh the assignment only every 10s or when allTasks length changes).
4. GUIDED LABEL: when window.GuildVisitor exists and stands within 1.4 tiles of a pedestal, that pedestal's plaque glows (soft gold outline) and a caption line floats above it ('done — the guild remembers', 'pending — the guild waits', 'failed — the guild learned').
5. update guards on window.V && V.gameState === 'play'; zero exceptions if allTasks is missing/empty (draw pedestals with 'the archive is empty... for now').

OUTPUT: only the new file, wrapped in one standard fenced code block (three backticks, no language tag). One line of prose max outside the fence.

tasks.spec:
Create a NEW ES-module worker_purpose.js — the VISITOR'S PURPOSE: a reputation system where the visitor endorses quests and gains standing with the guild. Be QUIRKY. worker_visitor.js (injected) is your PATTERN; worker_office.js (injected) is REFERENCE ONLY.

Contract (all on window): V (V.gameState, V.allTasks array {id,title,status}, V.workerStates, V.workers with recent_ticks), iso(gx, gy), fitText, window.GuildVisitor {gx, gy, dialogue}, window.cue optional (names: 'done', 'levelup', 'grow', 'alert', 'meow').

BEHAVIOR — window.GuildPurpose = { rep: 0, rank: 'NOVICE', endorsed: [], ceremony: null } with update/draw/__probe (probe returns { rep, rank, endorsedCount }):
1. ENDORSE: listen for 'e' keydown (one-shot flag). When the visitor (window.GuildVisitor) is within 1.5 tiles of a WORKING worker (V.workerStates[i] with workerState 'WORKING' or mode 'in_progress'/'pending') AND the visitor is not already in dialogue (GuildVisitor.dialogue is null), endorse that worker's focused quest: pick the newest pending/in_progress task id from V.allTasks (or from that worker's task list if available). Record it in endorsed[]. Show a small gold checkmark burst above the visitor + a line: 'the guild accepts your endorsement.' Only ONE endorsement per worker per session (cooldown list).
2. REWARD: watch V.allTasks each update; when an endorsed task id flips to status 'done', rep += 1, trigger CEREMONY: 3s of gold sparkles around the visitor, a banner line 'THE GUILD THANKS ITS PATRON (+1 REP)' in the level-up style (gold #d4af37 on dark #0d1324, centered, fades), and window.cue('levelup') inside try/catch if present.
3. RANKS: rep 0-1 NOVICE, 2-3 FRIEND, 4-5 PATRON, 6+ LEGEND. Draw a PATRON LICENSE CARD bottom-left of the canvas (above the chat panel if space is tight): small parchment card (#e8e6df fill, #6b4a2f border, 2px) reading 'PATRON LICENSE / rank: X / rep: N / endorsements: list of ids (max 3 shown)'. Clipped + measured text, never spill.
4. update guards on window.V && V.gameState === 'play'; zero exceptions if GuildVisitor or allTasks missing (license card simply shows 'the visitor has not arrived yet').

OUTPUT: only the new file, wrapped in one standard fenced code block (three backticks, no language tag). One line of prose max outside the fence.
